description: Minimal data inventory for the standalone Millbygard Minecraft/geodata side project.

files.purpose: Merged workarea used as the clipping boundary.
PostGIS-derived lookup proof exported from the Miljobeslut data source.
Coverage circle plus visible property boundary overlay for map/QGIS planning.
4:1 farm detail zone, soft transition ring and 1:1 property context zone.
Tower anchor point from the highest valid elevation cell inside the property workarea.
Orthophoto for buildings, roads, yard, vegetation and surface patterns.
Elevation model / DEM for terrain and WorldPainter heightmap generation.
Clipped 0.25 m surface model / DSM from Ythojdmodell 2024 for roofs, trees and surface-height checks.
DSM minus markhojd, used as first-pass above-ground height support.
Clipped true orthophoto from the Ythojd delivery.
Clipped Lantmateriet building polygons for the main house, barns and outbuildings.
Approximate building length, width and area from clipped building polygons.
First-pass roof/surface heights from ythojd above-ground raster inside building polygons.
Supporting cadastral layer for orientation and verification.
